authoritative_requirements: assignment.json complete body; all acceptance criteria implemented in analyze.py
target: generator-defined fundamental relative to A220; no perceptual identity assertion
vocabulary: integer -24..24 semitones relative to observed final pitch, plus unknown; truth offsets ±3/4/5 all covered
rendering: stimuli.py concrete formulas; short=.10+.0007*i, long=.22+.0013*i; i=0..39 disjoint tuples; eval long >=.2408 unseen. fundamental always nonzero; rich amplitudes [.32,1,.30]; moderate [1,.40,.22]; normalized RMS .08/.12; direction and level balanced across binding labels
structural_rule: Two silence blocks immediately before cue and one between 4-note demo chunks prohibit accidentalcross-boundary matches. Distinct Q/R middle notes, opposite-sign Q successive intervals relative to preceding study; no evaluation rejection.
controls: reset before current 3-note cue; removal replaces both demo successors by same-duration zero samples; swap inverts binding and target; shuffle reverses whole chunks; ambiguous repeats Q with both outcomes, identical prefixes and balanced targets
prior: new-model prior from development outcomes, frozen reference prior unchanged
selection: fit.py finite grid; same observe/candidates/distribution functions; candidate fixed order3 only cutoff .1/.3/.7 selected by dev accuracy then logloss then cutoff; transition orders1/2/3; absolute order3; recency order1. Calibration only temp .05/.2 sigma .08/.2 floor .001/.05 by logloss. No further tuning.
uncertainty: unavailable pitch propagates as None; no filling with metadata

bootstrap.unit: 24 equally weighted groups, paired across models/cells
bootstrap.familywise: Bonferroni percentile intervals for each of three changed-minus-matched contrasts: quantiles .05/6 and 1-.05/6; simultaneous coverage by union bound, approximate bootstrap

proper_scores: logloss cross entropy on stipulated target distribution without clipping, zero positive-target mass => infinity. Brier expected realized categorical squared error = sum((p-y)^2)+1-sum(y^2); ambiguous adds .5.
oracle: Only after saved acoustic forecasts: substitute arrived generator fundamental for pitched blocks; masked/pause None; preserve reset and history ordering, same frozen code/config. No oracle data enters subprocess. Evaluate all six models but diagnostic only; C observation requires both acoustic fail, candidate oracle pass, joint gain>=.10 and lower95>0. If oracle fails, only saved lookup/availability inspection can localize, else inconclusive.
branches: A reference passes first; B candidate passes and joint gain>=.1 lower95>0 proper scores no worse; C specified diagnostic; else inconclusive. Conditions in assignment.json; no next study automatically.
probability_target: For each predictor, bin the generator fundamental minus its observed anchor to nearest semitone; outside vocabulary or no anchor -> unknown. Thus octave errors affect proper scores as well as absolute point accuracy. Oracle uses its own true anchor. Quantization error separately reported. Scores do not assert within-bin perceptual equivalence.
pre_evaluation_revision: Development/calibration streams each run once; saved observations reused for finite-grid selection after fixing scoring coordinates before evaluation. Original per-event diagnostic scores retain their earlier relative-coordinate definition; fit selection and final analyzer use explicit observed-anchor coordinates.
evaluation_counterbalance: Before evaluation: independently cross rich/moderate family with both renderer directions in evaluation (6 groups per combination); training direction and rich family were confounded. Rich demonstration→simple cue is a predefined withheld combination; no evaluation outcomes inspected. Order alternates by four-group block. Every binding pair shares renderer/RMS so these never predict binding label.
compute_accounting: Record whole work wall interval as conservative upper bound on aggregate single-worker compute, plus split runtimes; all commands sequential, no parallel pipelines.
